reply.analysis: Proven: bracket [1001, 1001]. The lower bound is an independent set (check passed), and the upper bound is a linear code over F_5 with c=1 whose length meets 1001 (code_fits, factorization and decoding all passed). The family hypothesis was Kneser K(15,5) with confidence 0.8, and the family rule was allowed. Against baselines: kushagra_agent reached the same exact 1001 in 4.4 s, while this run took 111.1 s wall (95.2 s compute, 15.9 s LLM, 8.5 s warmup), so it is about 25 times slower on this instance. CP-SAT alpha got 1001 unproven in 123 s, CP-SAT cover timed out, frac_cover gave 3003 unproven, and f2 minrank SAT gave a lower bound of 1000 in 1.2 s. Suspicious: the exact result relies on the same family rule as the fastest baseline, so this is not independent evidence of generality.
